lede: The most consequential action this week happens Wednesday, when SMART's board votes on two vendor contracts — one for gondola structural analysis, one for cabin structural analysis — that will shape whether the aging gondola has a future. That same day, Town Planning and Zoning takes up the Carhenge Redevelopment Project, a large-scale subdivision consolidation on Town-owned land at 700 W Pacific, along with other Town-initiated development concepts in the Accommodations 2 zone. Rounding out the week, the Town Council sits as Liquor Licensing Authority Sunday to hear KOTO Radio's permit request for its Live at the Drive event.

notable.stake: Town-owned Carhenge site up for subdivision consolidation and concept review.
Two vendor contract votes decide who analyzes the gondola's structural future.
Public hearing on KOTO's special event liquor permit for July 30 concert.
